page.title: Payouts
page.intro: Track the amounts held in escrow, released, held in reserve and paid out, plus your payout history.

blocked.PROVIDER_DISABLED: The provider does not allow payouts yet

account.title: Payout account
account.none: You have not connected a payout account yet. Once connected, your released balance is paid on your schedule.
account.scheduleCurrent: Current schedule: {schedule}. To change it, choose a new schedule and save.
account.scheduleNew: Your account will be connected with this schedule; you can change it later.
account.destinationDemo: Demo account; no payouts are made to a real bank account
account.destinationProvider: Your bank account is managed in Stripe
account.manageAtProvider: View or change your bank account in Stripe

policy: Funds are released from escrow {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} after check-in; a {commission}% platform commission is deducted and {reserve}% of your share is held in reserve for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
identityRequired: Identity verification is required for payouts.

balances.title: Balance
balances.caption: Balances by currency
balances.hint: The columns follow the order in which funds move; only the released balance is paid out.

terms.escrowMinor: The guest's payment is held by the platform and released, minus commission, {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} after check-in.
terms.reserveMinor: Held for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} to cover possible refunds and disputes, then moved to your released balance.
terms.availableMinor: Ready to be paid out; sent on your payout schedule.
terms.pendingMinor: Queued to be sent; it has not reached your bank account yet.

history.title: Payout history
history.caption: Recent payouts

failureReasons.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: The released balance was too low at the time of sending (for example, because of a later refund).
failureReasons.no_destination: No connected bank account was found. Check your payout account.
failureReasons.other: The payment provider could not complete the payout. If this keeps happening, contact support.
failureReasons.account_closed: The payout could not be sent because your bank account is closed. Update the bank details in your payout account.
failureReasons.account_restricted: The payout could not be sent because your bank account is frozen or restricted. Contact your bank or add a different bank account.
failureReasons.invalid_account: The bank account details are invalid or the account could not be found. Check and update your bank details.

history.limitNote: Only the latest {limit} payouts are shown. Download the full history for older records.
history.failedRetry: Any amount left in your released balance is sent with the next payout once the issue is resolved.

disclaimer: This is a portfolio project; it is not a real payment service.
